title: BEACON use case
description: An end-to-end evaluation: which forecasts are compared with which observations, on which fields, thresholds and regions.

id.description: Must match the file name without .yaml.

summary.description: What the case evaluates, in the words of its source.

source.description: Where the case comes from, e.g. a document and section.

forecasts.description: Dataset IDs of the forecasts compared.

reference.description: Dataset ID of the observations they are compared with.

message_types.description: PREPBUFR message types to use, e.g. ADPSFC for land surface stations.

domain.description: MET polyline (share/met/poly/<name>.poly) limiting which observations are converted.

profile.description: beacon-gui Decision Profile preset the GUI opens with when this use case is shown.

leads.description: Lead times in hours; also the spacing of valid times.

per_forecast.description: Score each forecast at the leads and run times it has between start and end (e.g. AIFS every 6 h to 240 h, HRRR every hour to 48 h), instead of requiring every forecast to have all of them.

gridded.description: Maps: every forecast and a gridded analysis on one latitude-longitude grid (MET Grid-Stat), for the GUI's Fields page and gridded scores. Uses the runs and valid times every step hours.

reference.description: Dataset id of the analysis, e.g. urma-2p5.

step.description: Hours between valid times, and between the runs used; divides 24.

grid.description: The box, in degrees north and east, and the grid spacing in degrees.

display.description: Name of the box, e.g. Southern Plains map box.

event.description: A dated weather event, for the event report: when it happened, at which stations, and what counts as dangerous and as a forecast calling it.

window.description: The event, used for detection, onset and duration.

display.description: The time shown on the report's charts; contains the window.

region.description: Name of the station-list region holding the event stations.

stations.description: Display name of each event station, by station ID.

danger.description: Dangerous conditions: all of these at the same station and hour. Each quantity and level must be one of the case's fields.

called.description: When a forecast run has called the event at a station.

min_hours.description: Dangerous hours needed, observed or forecast. A forecast with values every N hours counts one dangerous time as N hours. The onset is the first hour of the first spell of min_hours dangerous hours in a row (the first dangerous hour if there is none).

onset_tolerance_h.description: How far the forecast onset may be from the observed onset.

thresholds.description: Event thresholds for contingency tables, in the quantity's units, with a label in everyday units.

regions.description: Where scores are computed: a MET polyline or a list of station IDs.

name.description: Mask name as MET writes it to VX_MASK.

not_yet.description: Parts of the case this version can't evaluate, and why.

values.description: Several values of one level type, e.g. pressure levels.
